title: The mind is not transparent to introspection

statements.text: The dogma that mental life is self-intimating and introspectively available is ready for the museum of antiquated myths. A great deal of intelligent and sentient activity, perhaps most of it, goes on without self-conscious awareness, and this is the nature of the case, not a pathology. Introspection has proved much less thorough and reliable than supposed.

sources.quote: The venerable dogma that one’s mental life is self-intimating and introspectively available seems at last to be ready for consignment to the museum of quaint and antiquated myths about how humans work.
Introspection has been found much less thorough and reliable than previously supposed.
